description:
FOUND by the s536 ROUND BOARD (MAIN-READY-74 fcfcb5d3; reviewing session, 2026-11-08) and attributed by one-file bisect.

MEASURED (one-file `tools/run-dist-t.pl --rows ~/.cpan/build/Capture-Tiny-0.50-0 t/FILE`, serial, logs `~/pcl-agent-scratch/s536/round/`):
  1191fa1a (-72, s532c's base): 15-stdin-tied 873/0 plan 873; 22-stdin-badtie 583/0; 23-all-tied 875/2 (rows 875 876 = #3434, blessed); 24-all-badtied 587/0.
  40b09ef5 (s532c's FIRST code commit) and every later s532c commit, and main: 15 = 91 then exit 22, no plan; 22 = 3 then exit 255; 23 = 93 then exit 22; 24 = 5 then exit 255.
  The other s532c commits (4f14b12b #4304/#1486, dcdac02d #4502) do not change it: 40b09ef5 alone.

THE DIE (a $SIG{__DIE__} logger prepended to a copy of 15-stdin-tied.t): `Error from open(GLOB(0x1), <&=): Invalid argument` errno 22, from Carp::confess in Capture::Tiny::_open, called by Capture::Tiny::_proxy_std (lib/Capture/Tiny.pm:123 `_open \*STDIN, "<&=" . fileno($dup{stdin})`) under _capture_tee, at the FIRST capture_stdout case (t/lib/Cases.pm: `capture { $inner = capture_stdout { ... } }`) after 91 capture / capture_scalar cases.  So `fileno($dup{stdin})` answers undef/empty: $dup{stdin} was opened by `_open $dup{stdin} = IO::Handle->new, "<&=STDIN"` (line 129) in an earlier capture while STDIN is TIED (TieLC: `tie *STDIN, 'TieLC', "<&=STDIN"`; its TIEHANDLE returns `\do { local *HANDLE }`) and Capture::Tiny does `local(*STDIN), _open(\*STDIN, "<&=0")` (line 342) for a tied STDIN.

NOT REPRODUCED in isolation (scratchpad ct/c.pl d.pl e.pl: package dups `<&=STDIN`, `local *STDIN` + `<&=0`, a dup of a tied STDIN, an element-assignment open target -- all = perl on main): the state needs the earlier captures.  Suspects inside 40b09ef5: (a) the #1423 read half -- "a glob designator resolves in its own package FIRST": a `STDIN` / `*STDIN` read inside package Capture::Tiny or TieLC after `local(*STDIN)` may now reach a Capture::Tiny:: / TieLC:: glob (STDIN is a FORCED-MAIN name -- `Pl::Environment::forced_main_name`, s532b #4163); (b) #4301 `p-glob-defined` -- a `defined *{...}` / `defined fileno` path that used to answer true now answers the honest false and takes a different branch.  CHEAP DISCRIMINATOR: revert each half of 40b09ef5 on a scratch tree (the #1423 resolver change alone, the p-glob-defined emission alone) and run 15-stdin-tied.t -- 2 runs.

OWNER: s532c (fix-forward of its own merge).  ROWS: baselines/cpan-board14-fails.tsv is NOT edited -- the four files read as NEW *PLAN* rows on the round board until this is fixed (the fix restores the -72 counts above).
